text: 国际货币基金组织(IMF)驻华首席代表马歇尔·米尔斯谈及地方行动，对天津的探索表示赞赏。 他分享道，其父20世纪90年代曾在天津参与一家合资企业的运营，助力当地工业化，如今很高兴看到天津正拥抱更加多元化的经济新篇章。 米尔斯说，天津的转变正是中国经济加速再平衡的缩影。（中新网）
text_en: Marshall Mills, IMF Chief Representative to China, expressed appreciation for Tianjin's exploration when discussing local actions. He shared that his father participated in running a joint venture in Tianjin in the 1990s, aiding local industrialization, and is now glad to see Tianjin embracing a more diversified economic new chapter. Mills said Tianjin's transformation epitomizes the accelerated rebalancing of China's economy. (Chinanews.com)
